snObjectGuard.enabled.description: Enable or disable SN Object Guard automated checks.

snObjectGuard.configFile.description: Path to workspace configuration file relative to workspace root.

snObjectGuard.checkOnSave.description: Automatically check higher instance version before saving local file.
